statement: The function returns a result r, and r equals the number of Node occurrences n in root for which every node in the subtree rooted at n has the same value as n. If root is Null then r = 0.
preconditions: root has at most 1000 Node occurrences, and every Node value v satisfies -1000 <= v <= 1000.

statement: The function returns a result r; in particular, it does not fail (no overflow, panic, or out-of-bounds access).
preconditions: root has at most 1000 Node occurrences; node values may be arbitrary 64-bit integers.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, 0 <= r <= N, where N is the number of Node occurrences in root.
preconditions: root has at most 1000 Node occurrences; node values may be arbitrary 64-bit integers.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = N, where N is the number of Node occurrences in root.
preconditions: root has between 2 and 1000 Node occurrences, every Node value lies in [-1000, 1000], and any two Node occurrences in root have equal values.

statement: The function returns a result r and r >= L, where L is the number of leaves in root, i.e. Node occurrences whose left and right children are both Null.
preconditions: root has at most 1000 Node occurrences and every Node value lies in [-1000, 1000].

statement: The function returns a result r_out. Let r_l be the result of count_unival_subtrees(l) and let r_r be the result of count_unival_subtrees(r); then r_out = r_l + r_r.
preconditions: root = Node(v, l, r) with at least one of l, r not Null; root has at most 1000 Node occurrences; every Node value lies in [-1000, 1000]; and every Node occurrence in l or r has a value different from v.

statement: Let mirror(root) be the tree obtained recursively by replacing each Node(v, l, r) with Node(v, mirror(r), mirror(l)) and leaving Null as Null. If the function returns r on root and r_m on mirror(root), then r = r_m.
preconditions: root has at most 1000 Node occurrences; node values may be arbitrary 64-bit integers.

statement: If the function returns r on root and r_f on T_f, then r = r_f.
preconditions: root has at most 1000 Node occurrences; f is an injective function from the set of node values occurring in root into the set of 64-bit integers. Let T_f be obtained by replacing each Node value v with f(v).

statement: The function returns a result r and r = L, where L is the number of leaves in root (Node occurrences whose left and right children are both Null).
preconditions: root has at least 2 and at most 1000 Node occurrences, every Node value lies in [-1000, 1000], and for every Node occurrence n with a non-Null child c, the value of n differs from the value of c.

statement: The function returns a result r_out. Let r_r be the result of count_unival_subtrees(r). Then r_out = r_r + 1 if every Node occurrence in r has value v, and r_out = r_r otherwise.
preconditions: root = Node(v, Null, r) with r not Null; root has at most 1000 Node occurrences; every Node value lies in [-1000, 1000].

statement: The function returns a result r_out. Let r_l be the result of count_unival_subtrees(l) and let r_r be the result of count_unival_subtrees(r). Let AllEq_v(l) mean every Node occurrence in l has value v, with AllEq_v(Null) true, and define AllEq_v(r) similarly. Then r_out = r_l + r_r + 1 if AllEq_v(l) and AllEq_v(r), and r_out = r_l + r_r otherwise.
preconditions: root = Node(v, l, r); root has at most 1000 Node occurrences; every Node value lies in [-1000, 1000].
